what_this_audited: the EVIDENCE RECOVERY for nashville-tn: 84 first-party pages re-fetched and hashed, and the authority rewritten on them. No shared runtime module, schema, contract or assembler changed; tests/pettripfinder/pins/market_state.json did, and Regression V2 refuses to narrow a change set carrying shared test infrastructure. It is NOT the routine Nashville data release, which the fast release lane classifies and measures on its own: that receipt reads MARKET_AUTHORITY_DATA_ONLY and FULL_REGRESSION_REQUIRED_BY_LANE = NO.

the_classifier_cannot_see_this.what: the committed baseline manifest is older than the parent commit, so a node the PARENT already fails is reported TRUE_NEW. The split below is measured by running the named nodes at 35e4fd2631246ac0b961c17a75523b41725957f9.

PRE_EXISTING_AT_PARENT.not_closed_here: these fail at the parent too and are none of this order's doing. They are reported rather than absorbed: silently folding sixteen real failures into a PRE_EXISTING bucket is exactly the thing a baseline exists to prevent. Re-pinning the baseline at the Lexington-live commit is a separate order's work.

corrections.why: it failed at the parent for an ENVIRONMENTAL reason, not the real one: the node calls (REPO / 'data' / 'acquisition').iterdir(), and a fresh git worktree has no data/ directory (it is gitignored), so the call raised FileNotFoundError before the assertion ran. At HEAD it fails for the actual reason -- this order created data/acquisition/nashville_tn_recovery_static_003 and had not yet classified it. A node that could not EXECUTE at the parent is not proved pre-existing there.
corrections.closed_by: naming the run in test_store_integration_025.OTHER_MARKET_RUNS with what it was, what it cost and why the attended half has no directory beside it

closure.what_this_is: every node this order actually moved, fixed at its cause and re-run BY NODE ID. Regression V2 exists so this does not cost a second broad regression: the proof is the node the run named, not a repeat of the run.
closure.why_a_retired_gate_is_not_a_closed_one: a retired gate cannot be re-run: its premise is false and it no longer exists. Counting it as passing would let a deleted assertion read as an honoured one, so it is listed separately with the reason the promotion falsified it.
